stocks.discussion_driver: Qualcomm reported Q3 FY2026 earnings after market close on July 29, posting revenue of $9.9B that beat estimates while EPS of $2.21 narrowly missed the $2.23 consensus. Shares fell 4.49% during the regular session to $155.57 and plunged another 7.16% after hours to $144.53 as investors reacted to declining Apple-related revenue, cautious handset guidance, and a 20% YoY drop in handset segment revenue — despite record automotive revenue of $1.6B (+61% YoY).
bull_case: Record automotive revenue of $1.6B grew 61% YoY, and non-handset QCT revenue rose 28% YoY, demonstrating successful diversification beyond the slowing smartphone market
QCOM trades at just 15x forward earnings — a deep discount to semiconductor peers — with a 90%+ historical earnings beat rate providing a potential re-rating catalyst if handset guidance stabilizes
bear_case: Handset segment (59.8% of QCT revenue) fell 20% YoY, and declining Apple-related revenue signals structural headwinds as smartphone upgrade cycles lengthen and competition intensifies
Stock has fallen 40% from its 52-week high with compressed margins; the after-hours decline to ~$144 following Q3 results suggests further near-term downside risk

stocks.discussion_driver: SoFi reported Q2 2026 results before market open on July 29, beating estimates with revenue up 42% YoY to $1.22B and EPS of $0.12 vs $0.11 estimate, while raising full-year revenue guidance to $4.75-$4.85B. Despite the operational beat, shares fell ~9% as the stock was already down 50%+ from its 2026 highs and broader market weakness driven by the Fed's hawkish triple dissent added to selling pressure.
bull_case: Record 15.8 million members (+35% YoY) and 24.4 million products (+42% YoY) confirm the banking super-app model is gaining traction, with management confidence reflected in raised full-year revenue guidance
Reaffirmed $0.60 full-year EPS guidance alongside raised revenue targets demonstrates improving unit economics and a clear path to sustainable profitability in its financial services platform
bear_case: Stock is down 53% from its $32.73 52-week high; despite the Q2 earnings beat, the market sold the news — suggesting persistent investor skepticism about consumer credit risk under a prolonged high-rate environment

Fed's hawkish stance (3.50-3.75% rates, triple dissent) could pressure SoFi's lending margins and elevate loan delinquency risk; 14% of covering analysts maintain Sell ratings reflecting ongoing profitability concerns

stocks.discussion_driver: Bloom Energy delivered a blowout Q2 2026 earnings report on July 28, posting record revenue of $1.065B (vs $827M estimate, +165% YoY) and EPS of $0.78 (vs $0.42 estimate), while raising full-year revenue guidance to $3.9-4.2B — 8.2% above prior consensus. The stock surged 11% intraday on July 29 before volatile session dynamics erased most gains, as a prior short-seller attack from Hunterbrook and the broader bear market kept pressure on the name.
bull_case: Record $1.07B quarterly revenue and a $20B backlog driven by AI data center power demand positions Bloom as a critical infrastructure provider with exceptional multi-year revenue visibility

Clear Street initiated Buy at $290 and multiple analyst upgrades followed the earnings beat; fuel cell technology offers a low-emissions alternative to diesel generators for hyperscaler power needs at scale
bear_case: Trailing P/E is essentially meaningless (near-infinite) given minimal historical earnings; the stock has fallen 53% from its $351.28 52-week high, suggesting prior valuation expansion significantly outpaced fundamentals

Short-seller attack from Hunterbrook triggered a 13% selloff the day before earnings, raising governance and disclosure concerns; competition from grid-scale batteries and utility partners could erode Bloom's data center power advantage

stocks.discussion_driver: Ford Motor shares climbed 3% on July 29 after reporting Q2 2026 adjusted earnings that beat expectations and raising its full-year 2026 earnings outlook. Citi simultaneously upgraded Ford to Buy from Neutral with a $20 price target, while JPMorgan raised its target to $17. Ford's Pro commercial vehicle division and hybrid lineup continue to outperform expectations, though ongoing EV investment losses remain a drag on consolidated reported earnings.
bull_case: Q2 earnings beat and raised 2026 guidance reflect Ford Pro commercial strength and hybrid lineup demand, with Citi's $20 Buy target implying ~31% upside from current levels and JPMorgan maintaining Overweight

Ford stock is +11.9% YTD, outpacing the S&P 500's +8.3% gain, demonstrating resilient earnings power despite macro headwinds — and the Pro commercial segment commands significantly better margins than EV
bear_case: Trailing P/E is negative (net losses on a trailing basis) as ongoing EV segment losses continue to depress reported earnings; mean analyst price target of $15.60 implies only ~2% upside from current levels
Tariff uncertainty and potential auto trade disruptions under current trade policy create supply chain and pricing risks, and the stock already trades above the consensus analyst mean target

stocks.discussion_driver: Texas Instruments was upgraded to Buy from Neutral at Arete Research on July 29 with a $405 price target — one of the highest on the Street — citing semiconductor cycle recovery accelerating into H2 2026. TXN had already beaten Q2 estimates on July 22 with 52% YoY EPS growth and revenue of $5.46B, prompting target raises from Baird ($385), UBS ($380), and Rosenblatt ($350), reflecting broad Street conviction in the analog chip cycle recovery.
bull_case: Strong Q2 EPS growth of 52% YoY with industrial, automotive, and data center revenue all accelerating signals the semiconductor upcycle is gaining momentum with TXN as a key beneficiary heading into H2 2026

Arete Research Buy upgrade with $405 target and broad analyst consensus raising targets (Baird $385, UBS $380, Rosenblatt $350) reflects high conviction in TXN's dominant analog position and multi-year cycle recovery thesis
bear_case: Trailing P/E of 49.79x reflects a premium valuation pricing in a sustained semiconductor recovery — any inventory correction or demand slowdown in industrial/automotive markets could trigger significant multiple compression

Stock has declined from $294 post-earnings to $276 over the following week, suggesting institutional selling into strength; the stock remains 17% below its 52-week high with mean analyst target implying only ~16% upside
